events.name: Oak's Letter: The Sky Trio

remembers.notice: Articuno is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Articuno flies up to meet the other two. For a moment the three of them hang together in the sky, and then it comes home.

effects.text: Articuno went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Articuno knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Articuno.

success.text: Articuno lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Articuno offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The letter is in Professor Oak's hand, and it is addressed to the sky.

You followed its map to a cliff above the sea. The three birds who tested you are circling. One of them comes lower.

The last line of the letter: "If they let you near, do not waste it."

success.text: Articuno lands on the cliff edge. The wind goes cold and very still. It wants to see how far you have come.
You leave the letter on a flat stone, weighted with a pebble. A blue feather drifts down onto it. Your team breathes easier.

events.name: Works Key: Power Plant

remembers.notice: Zapdos is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Zapdos goes in alone. Every light in the plant flashes once, a greeting, and it comes back crackling and pleased.

effects.text: Zapdos went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Zapdos knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Zapdos.

success.text: Zapdos lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Zapdos offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The Works Key fits a rusted door that has not opened in years.

Inside, the old power plant is dark. Then every dead bulb in the hall lights up at once, buzzing.

Something at the far end remembers you from the storm.

success.text: Zapdos spreads its wings across the turbines. The lights go white. It wants a rematch, and it is laughing.
You throw the main switch to OFF and leave a full Elixir by the door. The bulbs dim, one by one, almost gently.

events.name: Secret Key: Hidden Volcano

remembers.notice: Moltres is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Moltres dives into the crater and comes up shining, every feather new. It shakes the sparks off over your team.

effects.text: Moltres went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Moltres knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Moltres.

success.text: Moltres lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Moltres offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The Secret Key opens a gate on the volcano's slope that nobody marked on any map.

The air shimmers. Ash falls like warm snow.

At the crater's lip, a bird of fire is waiting. It saw you pass its Trial.

success.text: Moltres rises out of the crater, wings dripping flame. It will not burn you. It wants to know if you burn back.
You leave a Charcoal on the gatepost. When you look back, it is glowing, and your team is warm to the bone.

events.name: Magma Stone: Stark Mountain

remembers.notice: Heatran is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Heatran walks into the lava as if it were a bath, and comes out glowing, and sits by your fire all night.

effects.text: Heatran went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Heatran knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Heatran.

success.text: Heatran lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Heatran offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The Magma Stone grew too hot to hold the moment you reached the mountain.

Deep inside Stark Mountain, the lava moves around an empty hollow. The stone fits it exactly.

The mountain wakes, and something steel crawls up out of the fire.

success.text: Heatran clings to the cavern roof, upside down, molten iron on its back. It drops.
You set the stone back in its hollow and step away. The lava calms. Something below rumbles, satisfied.

events.name: Silver Wing: Whirl Islands

remembers.notice: Lugia is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Lugia dives without a sound. The whole sea brightens from below, and it comes back up beside your boat.

effects.text: Lugia went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Lugia knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Lugia.

success.text: Lugia lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Lugia offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The Silver Wing hums in your bag the moment you reach the Whirl Islands.

The whirlpools you fought through on its Trial are calm now. The sea is holding its breath.

A silver shape rises from the deep, and it is looking at you.

success.text: Lugia rises with the sea behind it, a wall of water hanging on its wings. Its song shakes the rocks.
You let the Silver Wing float on the still water. It sinks slowly, glowing. The sea sighs, and your team rests.

events.name: Rainbow Wing: Bell Tower

remembers.notice: Ho-Oh is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Ho-Oh circles the tower nine times and every bell answers it. It comes down shining, and stays.

effects.text: Ho-Oh went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Ho-Oh knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Ho-Oh.

success.text: Ho-Oh lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Ho-Oh offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
Every bell in the tower rings when you climb the last stair. Nobody pulled a rope.

The Rainbow Wing from its Trial burns in your hand, seven colours at once.

A rainbow bird lands on the roof. It remembers what you did for the ones who were lost.

success.text: Ho-Oh opens its wings and the roof tiles catch fire without burning. It wants to see you stand in the light.
You hang the Rainbow Wing from the highest bell. It rings once by itself. Your team feels whole again.

events.name: MysticTicket: Navel Rock

remembers.notice: Lugia and Ho-Oh are both with you. Navel Rock goes quiet for them.

addChoices.label: Let them go up and down together.

success.text: One climbs, one dives. When they come back, they come back side by side, and the rock is warm from top to bottom.

effects.text: Lugia and Ho-Oh met at Navel Rock because you brought them both.

events.intro:
The MysticTicket came after you had answered one of them. Now Navel Rock rises out of the sea in front of you.

At the top, a rainbow that does not fade. At the bottom, water deeper than any light.

The ticket says only: CHOOSE.

success.text: The bell's note runs down the rock and out over the sea. The one it was made for answers.
Ho-Oh is waiting at the summit, in the rainbow. It lifts its wings.
Lugia is waiting at the bottom, in the dark. The water starts to turn.

choices.label: Leave the ticket on the rock.

success.text: You lay the ticket on the middle step. From above, a warm wind. From below, a cool one. Your team sleeps well that night.

events.name: Eon Ticket: Southern Island

remembers.notice: Latias is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Latias and the island's other shape fly a loop around the tree, laughing. Latias comes back with the sea in its eyes.

effects.text: Latias went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Latias knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Latias.

success.text: Latias lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Latias offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The Eon Ticket is stamped with a sea you had never seen until today.

Southern Island is small: one tree, warm sand, a ring of sea. Two shapes circle above the tree.

One of them is the girl from the canal city. She came to say thank you.

success.text: Latias swoops down and stops a hand's width from your nose. It wants to play, and it plays hard.
You leave the ticket under the tree with a Soul Dew's worth of flowers. Latias sings above you, and your team feels lighter.

events.name: Light Stone: Reshiram

remembers.notice: Reshiram is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Reshiram looks at the stone it slept in for so long, and then at you. It chooses the road.

effects.text: Reshiram went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Reshiram knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Reshiram.

success.text: Reshiram lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Reshiram offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The tower answered you, and now the Light Stone will not cool down.

It pulls you to a white field where the snow melts in a ring. In the middle, the stone opens like an eye.

Reshiram has not forgotten what you said you believe.

success.text: White fire pours out of the stone and becomes Reshiram. It asks, without words, whether you still believe it.
You set the stone down in the melted ring and say what you believe out loud. The fire dims to a warm glow.

events.name: Dark Stone: Zekrom

remembers.notice: Zekrom is already with you. It knows this place.

success.text: Zekrom looks at the dark stone, then at you, and the storm in its tail goes quiet. It chooses the road.

effects.text: Zekrom went back to the place its key opened, and came back to you.

remembers.notice: Zekrom knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Zekrom.

success.text: Zekrom lowers its head into your hand. It has been watching the whole road, and it has decided.

effects.text: Zekrom offered itself at the place its key opened.

events.intro:
The tower answered you, and now the Dark Stone crackles in your bag every night.

It leads you to a black field where storms circle and never land. The stone opens like a fist.

Zekrom has not forgotten what you said should be true.

success.text: Black lightning pours out of the stone and becomes Zekrom. It asks whether your ideal is still worth a fight.
You set the stone down and tell it the ideal you still hold. The storm stops circling and moves on.

events.name: AuroraTicket: Birth Island
events.intro:
The AuroraTicket arrived the night you heard of the Visitor for the third time. Nobody sent it.

Birth Island is bare rock and one black triangle. As you step closer, the triangle shifts, and shifts again.

It is learning the shape of you.

success.text: You step when it shifts. It shifts faster. You keep up. The triangle splits open, and Deoxys comes out of it, curious.
You do not move. The triangle stops too. After a long time, it opens, and Deoxys is standing there, copying your stillness.
You send out someone new. The triangle turns to look. Deoxys steps out wearing almost the same shape.

events.name: Old Sea Map: Faraway Island
events.intro:
The Old Sea Map turned up in your bag after the third story about the Ancestor. It is drawn in crayon.

Faraway Island is tall grass and warm wind. Something pink giggles somewhere in it.

The map has one more line, in the same crayon: FIND ME.

success.text: You look for an hour. It finds you first, every time, and laughs until it falls over in the grass.
You lie down and look at the sky. Something small lies down beside you and looks too.
The grass goes still. Then a pink head pops up right in front of you, upside down.

events.name: Liberty Pass: Liberty Garden
events.intro:
The Liberty Pass came after the third story about the Victory Star. It is stamped with a V.

Under the lighthouse on Liberty Garden, a basement door stands open.

Something tiny with a V on its head is sitting on the stairs, waiting to see why you came.

success.text: Victini grins and flashes a V at you with both hands. That was the right kind of honest.
You point at your team. Victini looks at them for a long time, then hops onto your lead's head.
Victini laughs, a small bright sound, and comes down the last stair to meet you.

events.name: Azure Flute: Hall of Origin
events.intro:
The Azure Flute came to you on the last road, because your Guest is still beside you and you never broke your word.

You play it. One note. Stairs of light rise out of the ground, step by step, into the sky.

At the top, a hall with sixteen pedestals. Someone is listening.

success.text: The stairs hold. Your team climbs behind you without a word.
The second note is for your Guest. It goes up the stairs first, and you follow it.
The stairs fade. The flute stays warm in your bag, but the hall does not open again this run.

events.name: The Flute Maker

remembers.notice: She hears the key in your bag before she sees it, and smiles.

success.text: She holds it to her ear like a shell. "Oh. Somebody earned this one." She plays the tune it hums, and your team sleeps sound.

events.intro:
A craftsman sits on a crate, playing a blue flute that is only nearly finished.

Flute Maker: "People used to come to buy this. I stopped selling. You cannot buy what it opens."
Flute Maker: "But I can tell you how it is earned."

success.text: "Keep one Promise all the way to the last road," she says. "A Mythical walks beside you; you never break your word. Then the flute finds you." She plays you a few notes of it.
"Hear of a Mythical three times and believe it. The ticket comes on its own. Wings and stones come from a Legendary's Trial. Nobody sells any of them. Not honestly."
She plays the unfinished song. It is beautiful, and it stops in the middle, and somehow that is right.

events.name: The Old Collector

remembers.notice: His eyes go straight to your bag. "You have one. May I see?"

success.text: He holds it up to the light with shaking hands. "I spent my life buying copies. This one is real." He will not take it. He gives you something of his instead.

events.intro:
An old man keeps a glass case of tickets and stones. Every one has a SOLD card, faded, and every one is a copy.

The Old Collector: "Tickets and wings and stones. People think they are bought. They are not. They are answers."
The Old Collector: "I can tell you who to ask."

choices.label: Battle him for his best piece.

success.text: "Show me your strength, then. Not for a ticket. For a good afternoon."
"A Legendary's Trial gives its wing, its stone, its letter. A Mythical, heard of three times, sends its own ticket. Go and listen to the road."
He tells you about the ones he never saw. He tells them like a man who still hopes.

events.name: Ruins Dig Site
events.intro:
Researchers dig at ancient ruins. Two hollows in the dirt, one scorched black and one scorched white, are empty.

Cynthia: "The stones were here. They left on their own, a long time ago."
Cynthia: "They only go to someone who answers the tower. Truth or ideals."

success.text: The black hollow is cold. The white one is warm. Between them, in the dirt, a carving of a third shape that is neither.
The team pays well, and Cynthia shows you a mural of two dragons back to back.

failure.text: Hard work, little to show. Cynthia thanks you anyway.

success.text: Cynthia draws you a map. "A divided town, and a tower above it. The stones will find you there, if you are honest."

events.name: The Dark Stone Fusion
events.intro:
The empty vessel has been cold and hungry all this way. Tonight it is not.

Kyurem and Zekrom face each other across your camp. The ice in Kyurem's hollow cracks, and black lightning crawls into it.

It is waiting to be made whole by whatever comes near.

success.text: Zekrom folds into the ice like a storm into a cloud. Black Kyurem stands up, whole for the first time, and roars at the sky.

effects.text: Kyurem took Zekrom into itself and became Black Kyurem.

success.text: You step between them. The lightning crawls back. Both of them look at you, and wait.

events.name: The Light Stone Fusion
events.intro:
The empty vessel has been cold and hungry all this way. Tonight it is not.

Kyurem and Reshiram face each other across your camp. The ice in Kyurem's hollow steams, and white fire pours into it.

It is waiting to be made whole by whatever comes near.

success.text: Reshiram folds into the ice like the sun into a frozen lake. White Kyurem rises, whole for the first time, and the snow around it melts.

effects.text: Kyurem took Reshiram into itself and became White Kyurem.

success.text: You step between them. The fire draws back. Both of them look at you, and wait.

events.name: The Reveal Glass: Tornadus
events.intro:
Your blessing is in Communion now, and the Forces of Nature know it.

A shrine in the middle of farmland holds a round glass. It shows the sky, the storm and the field, and then Tornadus, not as it walks with you, but as it truly is.

The glass asks if you want to see.

success.text: The glass flashes. Tornadus changes: the cloud falls away and the beast underneath stands up, wild and bright. Therian Forme.

effects.text: The Reveal Glass showed Tornadus as it truly is.

success.text: You turn the glass to face the field. The crops lean toward it, and grow a little taller.

events.name: The Reveal Glass: Thundurus
events.intro:
Your blessing is in Communion now, and the Forces of Nature know it.

A shrine in the middle of farmland holds a round glass. It shows the sky, the storm and the field, and then Thundurus, not as it walks with you, but as it truly is.

The glass asks if you want to see.

success.text: The glass flashes. Thundurus changes: the cloud falls away and the beast underneath stands up, wild and bright. Therian Forme.

effects.text: The Reveal Glass showed Thundurus as it truly is.

success.text: You turn the glass to face the field. The crops lean toward it, and grow a little taller.

events.intro:
Your blessing is in Communion now, and the Forces of Nature know it.

A shrine in the middle of farmland holds a round glass. It shows the sky, the storm and the field, and then Landorus, not as it walks with you, but as it truly is.

The glass asks if you want to see.

success.text: The glass flashes. Landorus changes: the cloud falls away and the beast underneath stands up, wild and bright. Therian Forme.

effects.text: The Reveal Glass showed Landorus as it truly is.

success.text: You turn the glass to face the field. The crops lean toward it, and grow a little taller.

events.name: The Meteorite
events.intro:
Deoxys is your Guest, and you have kept changing with it. Tonight a meteorite comes down beside your camp, small and still hot.

Deoxys touches it, and its body shifts through four shapes in one breath.

It looks at your team, then at you. Which shape, for the road ahead?

success.text: Its arms sharpen. Your whole team stands a little forward, ready to hit harder, until the region ends.
It thickens and settles. Your team feels harder to knock down, until the region ends.
It goes thin and quick. Your team moves first more often, until the region ends.
It settles back into itself. A little of everything, for everyone, until the region ends.

events.name: The Odd Keystone
events.intro:
The Odd Keystone has been getting heavier all run. Every Ghost-type you knocked out and let go left a whisper in it.

Tonight it has one hundred and eight. They are all talking at once.

The crack down its middle is glowing.

success.text: The stone splits. A hundred and eight voices pour out, swirl, and knot together into one grinning shape. Spiritomb follows you out of the mist.

effects.text: A hundred and eight spirits gathered in the Odd Keystone, and Spiritomb came out of it.

success.text: You carry the keystone to a shrine and lay it down. The voices go quiet, one by one, and say thank you. Your team sleeps without dreams.

events.name: A Researcher Recognizes Something

remembers.notice: She sees the blessing's object in your bag, glowing, and her hands start to shake.

success.text: She reads the old words on it out loud, and gets them right. "It chose you twice," she says. "The blessing, and then itself."

effects.text: A researcher saw your Legendary and its blessing together, and wept.

events.intro:
A researcher stops dead in the road and stares at your party.

Researcher: "That one. I have only read about it. Three books, all of them wrong."
Researcher: "Please. Let me record it. I will be quick."

success.text: She sketches fast, talking the whole time. When she shows you, the drawing is good. Your Legendary looks at it for a long time.
She tells you what the books got wrong, and what one old book got right. You learn a place your Legendary would like.
She stops, and puts the pencil away. "No. You are right. I am sorry." She bows to your Legendary, and it bows back.

events.name: A Researcher Recognizes Something
events.intro:
A researcher stops dead in the road. She is not looking at your party. She is looking just behind you, at your Guest.

Researcher: "Nobody has ever seen one walk beside a person. Nobody."
Researcher: "Please. Let me record it."

success.text: She raises her camera. Every photo comes out blank, except one: you, smiling, and a small blur of light by your shoulder. She gives it to you.
She kneels and asks, very politely. Your Guest thinks about it, then lets her draw it for exactly one minute.
She closes her notebook. "Then I never saw it." Your Guest comes a step closer to you, and stays there.
